d: Jharkhand BJP Strategy :jharkhand bijepi ke navniyukt prabhari Gajendra Singh Patel ne rajy ki rajniti, sangthan ki ranniti aur aagami giridih upchunav ko lekar bara bayan diya hai. unhonne kaha ki Jharkhand men vikas ki apar sanbhavnaen hain, lekin JMM-Congress sarkar ke karyakal men vikas prabhavit huaa hai. Patel ne bangladeshi ghuspaith, bhrashtachar, pariksha men garabri aur chunavi vade pure nahin karne jaise muddon par rajy sarkar ko ghera. unhonne kaha ki BJP sangthan men yuvaon aur Gen Z karyakartaon ko mauka degi. sath hi aadivasi samaj ke hiton aur SIR prakriya ko lekar parti…
